# muxt test puts its engine in place through go test's -overlay, so a second
# -overlay from the caller is refused before anything runs. The directory
# holds no Go source: were go test to run, it would print something.
# -mod and -modfile are refused for the same reason.

! muxt test -- -overlay=x.json
cmp stderr want-overlay.txt
! stdout .

! muxt test -- -mod=vendor
cmp stderr want-mod.txt
! stdout .

! muxt test -- -modfile alt.mod
cmp stderr want-modfile.txt
! stdout .

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- want-overlay.txt --
Error: go test flag -overlay cannot be passed through: muxt test uses -overlay to put its template engine in place of html/template
-- want-mod.txt --
Error: go test flag -mod cannot be passed through: muxt test sets -mod=mod and -modfile to require github.com/typelate/htt, muxt's template engine, in a copy of go.mod
-- want-modfile.txt --
Error: go test flag -modfile cannot be passed through: muxt test sets -mod=mod and -modfile to require github.com/typelate/htt, muxt's template engine, in a copy of go.mod
